test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ENTER' is written as 'UBWKH' and ‘SHIFT' is written as 'WCLEV'. How will 'TOUCH' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06c01734f8aa4c011a0a36a57e3bea6aebf56189f0aedd590f9d0d65a852ad3.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ENTER' is written as 'UBWKH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf44ddd33a80c55f2de980c24ba4770232608864ceb8e25385e0275f8303cc1f.png] 

And,

‘SHIFT' is written as 'WCLEV'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5541d22e1bba493b6c4bf5eec093cfedf6e7c3a70b679f379d18aa9f85258604.png] 

Similarly,

'TOUCH' will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/944091cb478ecb643822d0618ecf68c205c27ed1b108d126e3d60c3aceb0f2b8.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
